decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (OS Plan and 001. Received: 30th June 2016
002. Received: 22nd August 2016 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 31 Northumberland Crescent, Feltham.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved side extension, as a garage for the parking of vehicles, the boundary wall as shown on drawing number 002 received 22/08/2016  shall be erected at a height of no more than 0.6m and shall be permanently retained as such
description: Erection of a single storey rear and side extension
